svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Place the completed modules in their planned room positions; check level and alignment.
2. Join the bed bays / shared cabinet zones using the selected connector arrangement.
3. Anchor tall and overhead cases to suitable wall structure with temporary support.
4. Measure and cut the scribe strips to the actual wall / ceiling; the listed sizes are blanks.
5. Finish door gaps, drawer travel / retention, lighting and driver-access checks.
